summary: [standards] migrate declares `--backup` requires `--revert` and `--actor`/`--approver`/`--note` require `--relayed-via`, but clap does not enforce them when the call also carries the option that conflicts with the required one (clap skips a missing required arg that conflicts with a present arg): `migrate --commit --plan-digest D --relayed-via ask --backup f --actor a --approver b --note c` and `migrate --revert --commit --plan-digest D --actor x` pass the parser (answers PLAN_STALE / MIGRATE_REFUSED, not USAGE), so the document claims a refusal the binary does not give; the sweep of tests/arg_rules.rs builds one violating call per rule and never combines `--revert` with `--actor`; blast radius: the same quirk applies to any other `requires` whose target conflicts with another declared option (my exhaustive 2^n sampling of every command found only migrate)
